Uttar Pradesh Floods Affect Over 1 Lakh People

Heavy monsoon rains have caused severe flooding in Uttar Pradesh, impacting over 100,000 people. On Wednesday, authorities evacuated 16,784 individuals to safer locations. The floods have disrupted normal life and caused significant damage across affected districts. Rescue and relief operations are underway to assist the displaced population. The extent of the damage and the full impact on the population are still being assessed.
